parameters.sqlQuery:
SELECT l.client_id, l.list_kind, l.list_id
FROM `oneeighty-warehouse.ref.clickup_lists` l
JOIN `oneeighty-warehouse.ref.clients` c USING (client_id)
WHERE l.active AND c.status = 'active'
ORDER BY l.client_id, l.list_kind

-- Matches ops.pipeline_log exactly (008_create_ops.sql). A run that
-- logged the wrong column names would fail here and leave the sync
-- looking broken when the data had in fact landed.
INSERT INTO `oneeighty-warehouse.ops.pipeline_log`
  (run_id, workflow, source, started_at, finished_at, status, rows_loaded, error_msg, trigger)
SELECT
  GENERATE_UUID(), 'wf_clickup_to_bigquery', 'clickup',
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(),
  IF(COUNTIF(severity = 'error') > 0, 'partial', 'success'),
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `oneeighty-warehouse.ref.creative_tags`),
  IF(COUNT(*) = 0, NULL,
     CONCAT(CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING), ' sync issues; see ops.clickup_sync_issues')),
  'cron'
FROM `oneeighty-warehouse.ops.clickup_sync_issues`
WHERE DATE(synced_at) = CURRENT_DATE();
